question: True or false: wheat bred over the last century carries far more gluten than the wheat farmers grew around 1900?
answer: False. A 2013 review of US wheat records found no clear rise in protein or gluten content across the twentieth century. What did rise was gluten added as an ingredient: Americans' intake of vital wheat gluten, a powder bakers mix in, roughly tripled after 1977. The change came from the factory, not the field.
move: When a problem grows, check what was added before blaming what changed.
ask: When something in my life gets worse, do I look at what I added, or only at what changed?
trap: Modern wheat is blamed so often that the breeding story feels proven.
reference: Kasarda, Can an increase in celiac disease be attributed to an increase in the gluten content of wheat as a consequence of wheat breeding?, Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry, 2013
